passages.locator: Who invested and transcription of the 1602 shares register
passages.note: The Dutch national archive transcribes the Amsterdam VOC register: Grietgen Dirkx promised 60 guilders on 31 August 1602, using a mark; the register records other investors and their pledged sums.
